periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation slanting downward and inward toward the muzzle at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid with a vertical-to-horizontal axis ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the inferior-medial quadrant of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering the entire scapular region and extending fully down the forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, approximately twice the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistently rounded and convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-tan discoloration/staining on the white fur of the abdominal and thoracic regions.
